messages:
leah_sales: FYI NovaPay wants a short POC next week. They asked for a dedicated pool and a short autoscale bump for a fraud-check path. Target: ~6k tokens/min for 30m. Can we guarantee p95 under 300ms?

omar_solutions: are they strict about dedicated isolation? we can route hosted traffic to a higher tier but that won’t be isolated.

leah_sales: they require dedicated. Pool: ded-poc-novapay-eu, model requested: redwood-7b-v2. Current reserve = 1 GPU.

ravi_infra: options:
- temp reserve +1 GPU for the window (deterministic)
- keep 1 GPU and raise burst credits + extend burst window (soft guarantees)

Given "guarantee p95" go reserve. Also suggest a 10m pre-demo canary at 10% traffic and 5m drain.

tess_security: security asks from NovaPay:
1) scoped API key limited to pool ded-poc-novapay-eu and TTLed
2) enable per-request audit logs and ensure logs are delivered to a customer-specific bucket with 90-day retention
3) confirm PCI-adjacent controls (no card data in logs)

ravi_infra: we can mint a scoped key TTL=1h and apply a scrubber on logs to mask card-like numbers. Need bucket: s3://redwood-novapay-poc-logs and role redwood-poc-logs-writer.

sam_sre: also recommend setting fallback to redwood-7b-v2-quant in case of OOM. Canary + drain as ravi suggested. I'll add autoscale guardrails: max_concurrency_per_gpu and token_rate_limits.

leah_sales: and pricing? customer asked if short reserve incurs a commit or a one-off. need a written quote.

omar_solutions: for trial reserves we bill the reserved GPU hours as a one-off line item. I can approve a 15% demo discount. Finance wants the CR applied before issuing the invoice.

ravi_infra: creating change request. Config snippet:
```
pool_id: ded-poc-novapay-eu
add_reserve_gpus: 1
reserve_window: 2026-04-10T08:50:00Z/2026-04-10T09:30:00Z
canary: {percent: 10, start_before_mins: 10}
drain_cooldown_mins: 5
fallback_model: redwood-7b-v2-quant
```

deploy-bot: change_request CR-20260410-52 created by ravi_infra -> Actions: +1 GPU reserve on ded-poc-novapay-eu 2026-04-10T08:50Z to 2026-04-10T09:30Z, scoped API key TTL=1h, enable inference logs to s3://redwood-novapay-poc-logs. ETA ~20m.

ravi_infra: applying now. also adding log scrubber to strip PAN-like tokens and a note for legal to confirm PCI adjacency.

deploy-bot: CR-20260410-52 status: APPLIED by infra-runner at 2026-04-10T08:35:27Z :white_check_mark:

tess_security: confirmed key issued and stored in vault; bucket retention set to 90 days; scrubber in place. sending compliance note to legal.

omar_solutions: sending the demo discount line to finance. will attach CR id.

leah_sales: thanks team. please DM when keys are ready so I can hand them to NovaPay contact (eng@novapay.com). Demo scheduled 2026-04-10T09:00Z UTC. :rocket:
